prompt: What procedural rules govern Commission proceedings against GPAI providers under the AI Act?
assertions: Cites Implementing Regulation (EU) 2026/1755, published in the OJ July 21, 2026 and in force August 10, 2026
Covers model evaluations including API, source code and model access under Article 92(3)
Covers the appointment and independence of external experts
Covers fine proceedings: preliminary findings, the right to be heard, and access to the file
States the five-year limitation period for fines
